Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION DOCUMENT FOR RETROFITTING OF AIR-CONDITIONING SYSTEM IN FORCE TRAVELLER BUS Name of Work: Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning and Post-Installation Support for Retrofitting of Automotive Air-Conditioning System in Force Traveller Bus. 1. Eligibility Criteria Only the following shall be eligible to participate: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the offered Air-Conditioning system, or Authorised Reseller of the OEM. A valid Manufacturer Authorisation Form (MAF) issued by the OEM in favour of the bidder must be su bmitted along with the bid. Bids without valid MAF shall be summarily rejected. 2. Scope of Work The work includes complete retrofitting of a suitable automotive air-conditioning system on Force Traveller Bus. Scope covers: Supply of complete AC system along with all necessary accessories. Installation, structural integration, ducting, electrical and mechanical connections. Testing, commissioning and performance demonstration. Warranty support and post-installation service for 03 years. The system shall be compatible with the vehicle and Installation shall not adversely affect the structural int egrity, safety or existing systems of the vehicle. 3. Functional / Performance Requirements Parameter Minimum Requirement Type of Syst Suitable automotive air-conditioning system em Cooling Perf Adequate cooling capacity to maintain comfortable cabin temperature across all seating ro ormance ws under normal operating and high ambient conditions Good quality heat exchangers, tubing and components suitable for continuous automotive Construction use Air Distributi Uniform air distribution throughout the passenger cabin on Controls Easy-to-operate controls accessible to the driver Compatibilit Compatible with Force Traveller Bus. System and installation shall not cause abnormal load y on engine, electrical system or battery Safety & Du Proper mounting, vibration isolation, weather sealing and electrical safety features. System rability shall be durable for regular passenger transport use Note: Bidder shall offer a system of appropriate capacity based on the actual vehicle configuration. Detail ed technical data sheet of the offered system shall be submitted with the bid.

4. Installation & Commissioning Installation shall be carried out in a professional and workmanlike manner. All necessary fabrication, ducting, wiring, gas charging, leak testing and finishing shall form part of t he scope. Performance demonstration of cooling shall be carried out after installation. Brief operational guidance shall be provided to the user/driver. Vehicle shall be handed over in clean and roadworthy condition. 5. Warranty and After-Sales Support Comprehensive warranty on the complete system and installation workmanship: Minimum 12 mont hs from the date of successful commissioning. Free repair/replacement of defective parts and free service support during the warranty period. Bidder / OEM shall have adequate after-sales service arrangement and spare parts support for 03 Y ears. Response time for breakdown calls during warranty period shall be immediate. 6. Other Conditions The quoted rate shall be inclusive of supply, transportation, installation, testing, commissioning and warranty support. Delivery and installation timeline shall be as specified in the bid. Any damage caused to the vehicle during installation shall be rectified by the bidder at no extra cos t. 7. Documents to be Submitted Valid Manufacturer Authorisation Form (MAF) from the OEM. Technical data sheet / brochure of the offered AC system. Warranty terms and service support details. Compliance statement against the above requirements. .
